name: Acqua Panna
comment: NO₃ 2.1 mg/L (reported as 0.48 mg/L nitrate-as-N). HCO₃ derived from total alkalinity 90 mg/L as CaCO₃. K below detection limit. Still water (no CO₂).

provenance.source: Acqua Panna Water Analysis Report 2023 (Sanpellegrino S.p.A.); Panna Spring, Scarperia (Florence), Italy

name: Antipodes
comment: NO₃ 1.5 mg/L. Used for strong, pale, bitter ales

name: Apollinaris
comment: Used for dark, soft flavored beers. Apollinaris (Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler, Coca-Cola) — Apollinaris Classic/Selection mineralisation. Classic/Medium were withdrawn from German retail; Selection remains (gastronomy/export), same source water.

provenance.source: Apollinaris official mineralisation (Apollinaris Classic/Selection, Coca-Cola DE)

name: Aquarel Birken
comment: Used for dark, soft flavored beers. HISTORICAL / unverified-current: Nestlé Aquarel (Birken Quelle, Naturell) is no longer marketed in Germany — no current bottler source. Values from mineralwasser-test.com label transcription. Removal-sub-issue candidate.

provenance.source: mineralwasser-test.com label transcription (Nestlé Aquarel Birken Quelle Naturell) — brand discontinued in DE, no current source

name: Artificial mineral water
comment: Synthetic recipe: Ca:Mg 1:1, Na ≈ 125 mg/L, per Kulhavý & Čuta (Vodní Hospodářství B, 1973). The 1973 paper could not be located online; only the Na optimum is independently corroborated (Marcussen et al. 2020). HCO₃/SO₄/Cl values unverified against a primary source.

provenance.source: Kulhavý & Čuta, Vodní Hospodářství B 1973, 23(9), 222–6 'Effects of mineral content on the taste of water' (primary not located online); Na≈125 mg/L optimum corroborated by Marcussen et al., Foods 2020, 9(12), 1875.

name: Badoit
comment: Naturally carbonated. SiO₂ 27 mg/L, F⁻ 1.2 mg/L. Official badoit.fr table omits K, pH, TDS and CO₂; prior Khymos-2015 values for those fields dropped.

provenance.source: Badoit official composition page (badoit.fr — Tableau de composition, valeurs moyennes pour 1 litre)

name: SCA target (coffee brewing)
comment: NO₃ 0 mg/L. Target derived from the SCA (formerly SCAA) 'Water for Brewing Specialty Coffee' standard, which specifies Calcium Hardness 68 mg/L and Total Alkalinity 40 mg/L expressed as CaCO₃. Converted to elemental Ca ≈ 27 mg/L and HCO₃ ≈ 49 mg/L. Corrected from the prior Khymos encoding (Ca 68, HCO₃ 233) which read the CaCO₃ hardness figure as elemental Ca.

provenance.source: Specialty Coffee Association (formerly SCAA) — Water for Brewing Specialty Coffee standard (rev. 21 Nov 2009)
